HRA Analysis: SUNDAY SWEET TALK (3) was incredibly impressive recently when running a close up second in a stand start trial behind pacer Rostova. If she is able to do everything right early and begin safely from the stand start her main rival IM FRANKEE (5) is likely to face a very big task making up the 40m handicap. IM FRANKEE (5) faces a big handicap in this race which is double the handicaps she has been able to overcome previously in 20m. She started off the front in her latest start and was able to score a nice enough win there beating BOSTON BLIZZARD (1). BOSTON BLIZZARD (1) returned from a spell at Marburg when running second to POZZI TONOZZI (4)after making a break in the early stages. Having likely derived good benefit from her first up outing and with a safer beginning she can figure in the placings again. POZZI TONOZZI (4) was able to overcome a 10m handicap recently at Marburg when finding the front and taking them all the way there. She faces a 20m handicap this time and finds a much stronger race. SELECTIONS: SUNDAY SWEET TALK (3), IM FRANKEE (5), BOSTON BLIZZARD (1), POZZI TONOZZI (4) SUGGESTED BET: SUNDAY SWEET TALK (3) to win.

BLACK VIPER (9) got back two starts ago and was running on late into second behind Buster Dan at this same track and trip. He has been prone to doing things wrong in his races including last start when pacing before making a break last time out which took him out of play. ITS ALL RIGHT NOW (6) has been racing consistently in recent outings. Ran well two starts ago finishing second to Why Tanya Sue in a similar race to this one. She looks well placed again off a 10m handicap in this race and shouldn’t be too far away. LOCHINVAR SON (7) secured a good run behind the leader last time out and continued his consistent form when running second to Lizzies Son. He should get a good run close enough to the speed again in this race and shouldn’t be too far away. SMOKEY BEAR (3) wasn’t able to begin as quickly as he can last time out and found himself shuffled back early before running into second late behind Ogden at Marburg. He is well handicapped again in this race and if he can begin a touch faster this time he should secure the right type of run. SELECTIONS: BLACK VIPER (9), ITS ALL RIGHT NOW (6), LOCHINVAR SON (7), SMOKEY BEAR (3) SUGGESTED BET: BLACK VIPER (9) to win.

EXIT ELEVEN (2) has good early speed and should be able to drive through and lead in the early stages of this race from a good draw. He was able to lead and win his latest outing in mid September when beating Doublefault and Go Minnie who have both since won. LOTS OF HEART (7) didn’t have the best of luck recently on return from a spell when shuffled back on the pegs before charging through the line stylishly late once clear. He draws widest in this race but looks a horse with above average ability and is likely to have derived benefit from his first up outing. FAN THE FLAME (1) has the ideal draw in this race and looks set to get an economical run close to the speed. She was forced to sit without cover last time out and battled on nicely there behind stablemate Harry The Hat. She should run well again. FIT AND READY (4) secured a good run last time out and wasn’t beaten too far there behind stablemates Blackjack Bart and Better One. She should settle close enough to the speed in this race and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: EXIT ELEVEN (2), LOTS OF HEART (7), FAN THE FLAME (1), FIT AND READY (4) SUGGESTED BET: EXIT ELEVEN (2) to win.

READY TO DREAM (4) has impressed since landing in the stable of Ryan Vievers in QLD. He ran another good race finishing third in a race the winner Skip To Me Lou rated good time beating Claudes Desire. He looks ready to win. VINCENT TIME (3) secured a good run behind the speed last time out and was running on nicely there into second behind Glenledi Boy who has been racing in good form. He is a horse that loves to race close to the speed and from a good draw should run another good race. TORO LOCO (6) was well driven last time out to get in behind the leader early before being presented into the clear and wasn’t able to hold off Bigbashash late. He draws less favourably this time but appears to be close to another win. GIRL POWER (5) draws a touch awkwardly in this race towards the outside of the front row given she has seemingly done her best racing up on speed. She took on a strong enough race last time out and was forced to do the work but did battle on well there for third behind Sweet Lad Jujon. SELECTIONS: READY TO DREAM (4), VINCENT TIME (3), TORO LOCO (6), GIRL POWER (5) SUGGESTED BET: READY TO DREAM (4) to win.

JAY TEE TYRON (1) doesn’t have brilliant gate speed anymore but finds a race where there doesn’t appear to be any brilliant beginners and he may be able to lead early. He led last time out at Redcliffe over the 2040 when well beaten by The Tiger Army in a race the winner rated good time. THE REAL ROCKETMAN (4) ran well two starts ago when lead before handing over to Rocky Leigh and running a good second there. He had less luck in his latest outing when sitting without cover and battling away for sixth there. He appears close to another win. MILLIONDOLLAR KISS (2) hasn’t had a lot of luck in recent outings when racing off the pegs. She was forced to do the work outside the leader in a stronger race and was well beaten there but should find this a lot easier and does draw well. SKYLAR BREE (3) got back in the run and was finishing it off well there into third late in a race taken out by Jilliby Panda. She should get a good run again in this race and is racing well. SELECTIONS: JAY TEE TYRON (1), THE REAL ROCKETMAN (4), MILLIONDOLLAR KISS (2), SKYLAR BREE (3) SUGGESTED BET: JAY TEE TYRON (1) to win.

SON OF XENA (8) should get a good run through early in this race behind a horse which is likely to be keen to hold a forward position. He tracked into the race nicely last time out from off the speed over the 2138 at this track and was able to sprint nicely late to score over Fight For Victory. MAGNETIC STORM (1) has good gate speed and may look to drive through and lead in the early stages of this race from the good draw. He was forced to do the work outside the leader last time out and battled away well enough there for fifth not beaten too far behind Im Boo. RUBY RHAYNE BOW (2) has good early speed but does draw outside of a horse which also has early speed and may be keen to hold the lead in this race. She was forced to race without cover last time out and battled on well there beaten just 3.3 metres behind Kiki Meister despite the tough run. She looks hard to beat again. MAJOR CRUNCH (7) draws poorly outside the front row but does look quite well placed in this race and has been racing well in recent outings. He got back in the run last time out and was running on nicely late into the placings behind Kiki Meister at this track over the 1660. SELECTIONS: SON OF XENA (8), MAGNETIC STORM (1), RUBY RHAYNE BOW (2), MAJOR CRUNCH (7) SUGGESTED BET: SON OF XENA (8) to win.

ROCKY LEIGH (2) was able to find the front over the 2138 in this race and able to lead all the way there first up for the stable of Jack Chapple. He draws favourably again in this race and if he can find the front he is likely to be very hard to run down. PENNIE PACKER (5) appears well suited in this race dropping in grade off some of her better efforts. She got back in a stronger race taken out by Splashndash and just couldn’t quite get into it late. If she can secure the right run she should be right in the finish. ULTIMATE ARK (8) appears suited by the soft trailing draw but does follow a runner which may be shuffled back in the early stages meaning he will be relying on some luck to get into the clear. He got back and was running on late into fifth last time out in a race taken out by Bigbashash at this track in good time for the grade. LAZENA (1) appears likely to get a favourable run behind the speed in this race. She secured a good run on the pegs three starts ago and was running on well into fourth late behind Whata Good Feeling. She can bounce back into form on the pegs in this race. SELECTIONS: ROCKY LEIGH (2), PENNIE PACKER (5), ULTIMATE ARK (8), LAZENA (1) SUGGESTED BET: ROCKY LEIGH (2) to win.

MY ULTIMATE VICTOR (2) has very good early speed and should be able to find a prominent position from a good draw in this race. He led in a much stronger race last time out and just got tired late in a race he was forced to set a very genuine tempo early. KEAYANG KAUNA (10) was particularly impressive first up when working hard out in front over the 2138 and battling on nicely late for third. She then wasn’t beaten far last time out behind Kiki Meister in what may have been a stronger race. She draws awkwardly but looks set to run well again. MOONSHINE MILLY (1) has shown little to no gate speed which could make this draw a very tricky one for him in the early stages. He has been impressive this time in running well a number of times and if he could hold a forward position he would be hard to beat in a race of this nature. BLACKJACK (9) scored his second win last time out in three QLD starts when able to lead and just hold off Piccolo Diavolo in slow time at Redcliffe. He appears a horse which is likely to be better suited following and may just struggle a touch to put them away late at this stage of his career. SELECTIONS: MY ULTIMATE VICTOR (2), KEAYANG KAUNA (10), MOONSHINE MILLY (1), BLACKJACK (9) SUGGESTED BET: KEAYANG KAUANA (10) to win. The season at Burnie kicks off with a small maiden field, where Tammy Langley trains three of the six runners. VOODOO RANGER (5) continues to threaten to break his duck and again looks a strong chance here, even from the outside front-row draw. BLISSFULL RED (1) was held up until late first up in the state and gets the pole draw around the small Burnie circuit, so should get her chance for an all-the-way victory if she is able to push through and hold the front. ARRIVAL TIME (2) has run some handy races this campaign in the state and looks one of the clear dangers. CHASING THE ACE (6) and HIGH FROSTY (4) have shown some ability at the trials and look capable of improving with further racing, while SPORTY GRANT (3) will need to improve on recent performances to be winning here. Selections:BLISSFULL RED (1), VOODOO RANGER (5), ARRIVAL TIME (2), CHASING THE ACE (6)

Expecting some good speed early here, with all the horses off the front row known to possess gate speed when asked. This should allow a horse like KENYA (7) to put the foot down with a touch over a lap to go and try to outstay them, or potentially even earlier, as he regularly does in his races. QUEENOFDANCE (6) is another who should thrive off an early tempo and be finishing home strongly if she sees any open space. NATIONAL NEWS (8) could be the one at odds after dropping slightly in grade here. KNOCK OUT (4) is threatening to win a race but may have to be driven more quietly here with the known gate speed drawn to her inside. Selections:KENYA (7), QUEENOFDANCE (6), NATIONAL NEWS (8), KNOCK OUT (4)

A stand-start event over the short distance, where the sharp beginners in SAPPHIRE GAMBLE (3) and FLEETWOOD ROCK (4) will be looking to ping away and find the front, which would give both their chance to return to form. ITSMENOTU (1) returns from a let-up and, at her best, should be right in the finish with the chance to receive a soft run from the pole draw. TULLAH GIRL (5) enjoyed a nice run in transit when getting the money last start and will again be looking to find a spot on speed with cover, which should give her every chance to be running home strongly. Selections:SAPPHIRE GAMBLER (3), ITSMENOTU (1), FLEETWOOD ROCK (4), TULLAH GIRL (5)

REPETITIVE (2) is normally a reliable beginner from the stand and will look to jump in front here and attempt an all-the-way victory. It has been a while between drinks, but he won't get a better chance than what he appears to have here. EYE SEE AMOUR (3) has plenty of ability when he puts it all together and, if he steps safely at his second attempt from the stand, will take some holding out late. CHAMONIX (1) gets his chance to improve on his recent form from the pole, while ALBERIO (7) is a stand-start specialist and, even from the 10-metre handicap, should look to find a spot handy to the speed and could be the one at odds. Selections:REPETITIVE (2), EYE SEE AMOUR (3), CHAMONIX (1), ALBERIO (7)

RANIERI (3) looks to be the best beginner off the front row here and should appreciate getting back to Burnie, where he has a good record overall. CINCINNATI (1) and LA PIERRE (2) will be looking to take advantage of their good front-row draws and find spots on speed, which makes them the main dangers. COLORADO GIRL (5) and NO NUKES SKIPPER (9) look the best of the 10-metre markers and should be finishing off strongly if there is any genuine tempo throughout. Selections:RANIERI (3), CINCINNATI (1), LA PIERRE (2), COLORADO GIRL (5)

The last stand-start event of the night, where MIKI SANZ (4) will look to find a position on speed and run his usual honest race. OLLIES MEDAL (1) could either fly away or miss it badly from the pole draw, but if he begins safely, he could be hard to run down around the tight circuit. LIKEABLE ROGUE (2) could be the one at odds if he finds a nice spot on speed after not having much luck at his past few starts. ROCKS ROY (7) and CAN FEEL THE FURY (8) can never be left out in these sorts of races but will be relying on a good tempo to allow them to run home strongly, as will GOBSMACKED (6). SETTEBELLO (5) could also run a race at odds if he pings away as he usually does. Selections:MIKI SANZ (4), LIKEABLE ROGUE (2), OLLIES MEDAL (1), SETTEBELLO (5)

The mobile event for the No More Than Three Win horses, where ULTIMATE GLADIATOR (6) and SOHO TIGERLILY (10) clearly bring the best form into the race but draw awkwardly from wide and back-row gates. However, there does look to be some good tempo early from the front row, with TASSIE DAZZLER (3) and GEMMY LOU (5) involved. OSCAR MAC (1) makes his debut in the state and is first up for 16 months. He gets the pole draw but hasn't shown much gate speed in the past, so it will be interesting to see where he settles in the run. KING BART (4) and STANTON BREAK (8) are consistent placegetters in this grade and could be right in the finish with a nice run in transit. Selections:ULTIMATE GLADIATOR (6), SOHO TIGER LILY (10), KING BART (4), GEMMY LOU (5)

OUTBACK LASS (1) was narrowly defeated when leading last start and looks to get her chance to return to the winner's circle here. Expect her to hold up from the pole draw despite the speedy AWAY GAME (5) being drawn towards the outside of the front row, and she could be hard to run down. DANCINWIVJOLENE (3) should get a nice sit on speed and, at her best, looks the main danger, along with ALBY PRIDDY (4), who will be looking to slot in early. LALIBELA (9) and ONEOFTHELADS (10) will be relying on some genuine tempo throughout to allow them to run home strongly. SISTER PATRICK (12) has a tricky handicap to overcome but she has a massive motor. She was a winner first up at Gawler last start and she looks like a big threat tonight if she can trot smoothly and receive some luck. NOTHING I WANT (2), STAR OF PATRICK (6) and NO REMORSE (5) are all big threats in what is a very even race.

CLARENDEN TRIBUTE (5) has won three of his last five starts and is racing in some career best form. He finds a winnable race again tonight and he should travel well for Gaita Pullicino. RANGER RICK (1), ROCKNROLL SPIRIT (3) and IM ALL BUSINESS (11) are also chances.

ROCKIN GEMMA (4) was very impressive when she took out The Radiant at Port Pirie a few weeks back. She had a tough run in a heat of the SA Cup last week. She gets an ideal draw tonight and if she can get a quiet run and sprint home she will be hard to beat. CEE CEE LOU (3) is another who is racing well and he looks like a massive danger after a strong run in his heat of the SA Cup last week. HEZROCKINROYALTY (7) and FLY THE BANNER (2) are also chances.

CASTERTON (10) has won two of his three career starts. He was a dominant winner in his heat of the Golden Nursery last start when he defeated ONE AUSSIE by 8.6 metres. He will be extremely hard to beat tonight in the final. JADES REASON (1) was extremely tough last week when she was eventually run down by RANKINE. She will be a threat tonight from the inside draw. RANKINE (8) is undefeated so far and looks like a danger tonight even though tonight will be a lot tougher. KOJAX (6) looks the next best.

LUVTOBEUPTOME (4) was so impressive last week when he showed off his 400 metre sprint to defeat MAJOR BLITZ by 6.6 metres and ran a mile rate of 1.55.7. His last quarter of 26.6 was electric. It will take a major effort to beat him tonight. ZANDA MAN (8) didn’t work into it last week but he has the ability to feature tonight if he can receive some luck. MAJOR BLITZ (10) was another who was a bit disappointing last week but he can improve majorly tonight. STEAM MACHINE (1) looks the next best.

The main event for the evening and on the SA harness racing calendar. THE LAST TRIP (3) is well drawn tonight after his track record breaking run last week when he defeated HAPPY TOO YA by 8.6 metres and ran a mile rate of 1.55.5. It’s really hard to not see him getting beaten tonight. ULTIMATE VINNIE (1) will love the inside draw and he was tough last week when he led all of the way to defeat ABOUTTIME by 2.7 metres. SPRINGFIELD AFFAIR (5) and FORTY LOVE (6) are also big chances.

The Trotters Cup field has plenty of depth but there isn’t a lot of reliable form lines to go off. THE VICARS GIRL (10) was very disappointing in her runs leading up to her heat win last start. She defeated MORE WANTED by 3.9 metres in her heat after facing the breeze for a lot of the race. She has a lot of talent and if she can produce her best run tonight she should be hard to beat. ARTIGAS (1) will be a major threat tonight if he can step away cleanly from the stand start. REGAL ATTIRE (13) and BITTA IRISH LUCK (7) are also chances.

JAWSOFGOODTIME (1) has won her last two starts leading all of the way. She defeated ASHANTE PRINCE by 2.7 metres last start. It’s really hard to see her getting beaten tonight if she is at her best. FEARFULL DRAGON (8), ROCKAMARA (5) and WHATA OPTIMIST (11) are also chances.

CHASE THE STARS (4) ran two very good races in The Radiant series at Port Pirie a few weeks back. Tonight he finds a very winnable race and is a good chance of finding the lead. ASHANTE PRINCE (3), NORMY (1) and RUFF NUT (7) are also chances.

TUFFASNAILS (2) meets a tricky field tonight but his last two wins have been very impressive. If he can lead tonight he should be very hard to catch. KITTYKAT CUTIE (7) ran a very tidy race last start when she defeated NIGHT SPIRIT by a metre. She got a great run into the race but still sprinted very hard and looked magnificent hitting the line. She is a big threat again tonight. TWIN CONNECTION (3) and NIGHT SPIRIT (1) are also massive threats. OVERVIEW: This is a very even race with plenty of chances to open the meeting. ELIZAJANE (9) is in brilliant form, having won three of her last five starts. All of her recent wins have come when she has found the front. She will have a different race map here, but it should still suit her. She has the best sectional times in this event. BREATHE EASY (1) has great gate speed and is racing well. He has the option to hold the front or take a sit, but he is suited over the short trip. INTERPRETATION (7) is racing well despite her only fair numerical form. She has faced some tough race maps recently and comes up against another tricky barrier here, but with some luck, she is a winning chance. MISTER JIMARINGLE (5) was restricted for racing room late last start but looked to be letting down nicely. He is racing well and, if he can map favourably here, he is a great chance. Also respecting YANKEE MOJOH (11), who is flying at the moment. However, barrier 11 over the short trip at Kilmore will be difficult to overcome. SELECTIONS: ELIZAJANE (9), BREATHE EASY (1), INTERPRETATION (7), MISTER JIMARINGLE (5)

OVERVIEW:KIMCHI (9) drops in class here, having not contested an NR up to 40 race in quite some time. He has been racing well, has a good relationship with driver Taylor Youl and should be able to follow through at the start. THE LADYBIRD (5) was an eye-catching winner at Horsham last start. She found a good position midfield, was saved for one run and flew home to win nicely. If she can find a similar race map here, she can go back-to-back. MIKI MARK (7) is racing consistently well and has rarely finished outside the top five recently. He faces a tricky barrier here. TOMMYS LOOKOUT (6) is an interesting runner. At his last two starts, he has worked hard to find the front and tired a little late. He has the best last sectional times in this field. If he can slot into a good position without being used too hard early, he will be a threat late. Also respecting LAVADA GOLD (2) here. SELECTIONS: KIMCHI (9), THE LADYBIRD (5), MIKI MARK (7), TOMMYS LOOKOUT (6),

OVERVIEW:THREE SIX THREE (2) is a very well-bred colt making his debut. He is by Captaintreacherous out of Art De Triomphe, making him a brother to Gawn and Petillante. He used the sprint lane to win a trial at this track in late September, although it was in slow time. We will learn more about his ability here, and whatever he does, he will likely improve from the experience. AMANDO (3) is having his second career start. On debut, he tired and dropped out before being sent back to the trials. Although the trial was run in slow time, the way he won looked impressive. I am happy to give him another chance here. ELLIANA (11) came close to breaking through for her maiden victory on several occasions last preparation. She is first-up here and will be vulnerable from the tricky barrier, but she is one of the better horses in this field on exposed form. HEAVENLY NIKKY (9) is another horse who has come close to breaking through for her maiden victory on several occasions. She is racing well and now comes up against a tricky barrier, so she will need some luck to find clear running late. However, she is a winning chance here. SELECTIONS: THREE SIX THREE (2), AMANDO (3), ELLIANA (11), HEAVENLY NIKKY (9)

OVERVIEW:CRACKIN PHILTRA (4) has had only three career starts since November 18, but they have all been good runs. He returned to the track in October, racing in the breeze and fighting on strongly. He will improve with fitness and appears to be a classy type. LIBERTY STAR DUST (7) has the best sectional times on exposed form in this field. He finished second last start behind Cyclone Jenni at Cranbourne after flashing home. With the right run, he will be flashing home again. TRYX VIXEN (3) is a smart filly who is racing well and suits barrier three. ULTIMATE GRANGE (6) is having his fourth career start here. Forget his last run, as he had a flat tyre. His previous start was a nice win at Ballarat. I also have plenty of respect for JANSEN (5), who rarely runs a poor race. TOSWEETTOTAME (2) is a first starter here, but his trial form has included some well-beaten efforts. BACK: CRACKIN PHILTRA (4)– 4 units (win) SELECTIONS: CRACKIN PHILTRA (4), LIBERTY STAR DUST (7), TRYX VIXEN (3), ULTIMATE GRANGE (6)

OVERVIEW:MELICAN (6) is an exciting young filly for Rebecca Barley. She has had two career starts for two wins, with a cumulative winning margin of 44.9 metres. We are yet to discover her ceiling. FOREGONE CONCLUSION (1) is an experienced performer stepping out for his 205th start. He is racing well and should get a good run along the fence here. ALTIUS (2) is in great form after winning nicely first-up last start. With his great gate speed, he is likely to find the fence here. CATIES SON (8) is first-up but is the only horse on the back row. He has options from there. I also respect THE BLAZINBOOTS (7), who is in great form but faces a poor barrier. BACK: MELICAN (6)– 4 units (win) SELECTIONS: MELICAN (6), FOREGONE CONCLUSION (1), ALTIUS (2), CATIES SON (8)

OVERVIEW:TOBYS SHOUT (7) was ultra-impressive last start at Wagga. He was wide early, worked forward to the breeze and was simply too good late. He has the best sectional times in this event. The barrier is a concern, but he can make his own luck. ROCK POSTER (5) is third-up here and should be approaching peak fitness. She was too far back to get into the race last start, while at her previous outing she ran home nicely for third at Ballarat. She should improve with fitness but will need some luck from the barrier. THEROUX (3) found his best form last start to win at Ballarat. He was three-back on the fence, got wide late and ran home well. He has his winning confidence back. MISS PIGGY WIGGY (6) led and won nicely last start at Shepparton. She is unlikely to find the front here, but she is racing well. Keep an eye on HIGHVIEW HAMMER (4) early. He has good gate speed and, if he can map well, he also comes into contention. SELECTIONS: ROCK POSTER (5), THEROUX (3), TOBYS SHOUT (7), MISS PIGGY WIGGY (6)

OVERVIEW:TALKNPLAY (4) was first-up last start since December 2025 and was also making his debut for new trainer Mark Thompson. He led and was too good late. Expect an improved performance here with added fitness. KNOW THE SCORE (3) can be forgiven for his last start, when he galloped due to a gear malfunction. Prior to that, he had been racing quite well. He has a nice turn of foot. REASON TO LAUGH (5) has won two of his last three starts and is in career-best form. He is a good swooper and, if saved for one run, will be flashing home. SHEZABLUECHIP (6) raced in the breeze to win well last start at Shepparton. She faces a tricky barrier here but can make her own luck. SELECTIONS: TALKNPLAY (4), KNOW THE SCORE (3), REASON TO LAUGH (5), SHEZABLUECHIP (6)

OVERVIEW: This is a nice race, with every horse in the field appearing to be a progressive type with an exciting future. DECODE (6) is a nice horse for Chris Svanosio. He finished eighth last start in a Victoria Derby heat, running home nicely despite it being his first look at the 2760-metre trip. He is a very talented horse and ran a brilliant 1:50.7 at Wagga the start prior. Back to the shorter trip here, he will be hard to beat. DELIGHTFUL MIKI (5) ran home nicely to finish a respectable third at Melton last start. She is a smart mare. Abby Sanderson has two runners in this event, CAPTAIN MOLLY (1) and THE WISE GUY (7), and both have plenty of ability and look to be progressive types. However, both are first-up and may need the run. CAPTAIN MOLLY (1) is suited by barrier one and should get a good trip. THE WISE GUY (7) has not raced since August 2025, so he may be vulnerable from the barrier. STORM VENDETTA (2) won in nice time last start at Ballarat. He has a great turn of foot, but this is a tough race. BACK: DECODE (6)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: DECODE (6), DELIGHTFUL MIKI (5), CAPTAIN MOLLY (1), STORM VENDETTA (2) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

DIDYALOUSAROOSTA (2) has been in great form of late and draws an ideal gate in this even field. EVERYTHING BUT THE (1) is first up in a month and will be looking to make full use of the pole draw. You would expect LYNRYD SKYNRYD (6) to again push forward hard from his wide gate in an attempt to find a position on speed. He has been thereabouts of late but will need to improve to be winning here. WAZZA (3) should get a nice run just off the speed and be running home strongly, while WE SALUTE YOU (8) should get his preferred pegs run and could be the one at odds if the gaps appear late. Selections:DIDYALOUSAROOSTA (2), EVERYTHING BUT THE (1), WAZZA (3), WE SALUTE YOU (8)

An even field comes together for the No More Than One Win horses, where ROBUST SALLY (1) again draws the pole after breaking through for her maiden victory last start. This is obviously a tougher field, but she looks to get her chance again for an all-the-way victory. TISU SUNNY (3) gets the best draw he has had in a while and may look to take advantage of that, with plenty of ability on his day. LITTLE CAPPUCCINA (6) is another who broke her maiden last start and may look to zoom to the pegs to give herself her best chance. COMINSKI LEIS (8) is a back-row runner who has produced some nice races in his short career and would benefit from any tempo throughout, as will BRIGHTLY BLAZE (7) from the outside front-row draw. SNIPER SANZ (4) could be the one at odds if he races more genuinely this week, while SWEETHEART DIOR (2) also gets a nice draw to find a spot on speed and gets her chance after some consistent performances. Selections:COMINSKI LEIS (8), TISU SUNNY (3), SWEETHEART DIOR (2), ROBUST SALLY (1)

A two-year-old event for the maidens, where you would expect VINCENT THE THIRD (1) to look to take advantage of his good draw. He ran some nice races with slick last halves earlier in the year before having little luck of late, so expect him to be right in the finish here. ANN PENNY (3) was a well-backed favourite first up in the state and looked disappointing on face value, but was found to have had a flat tyre for the entire race, so her effort to finish as close as she did was commendable. BABY CHARLOTTE (4) is first up from a break after being handy on debut and should have taken plenty of improvement from that run. BETTOR CALL LOU (7) was seen flashing home late in a slowly run race first up from a break and will benefit from any genuine tempo throughout to be running into the finish. Selections:VINCENT THE THIRD (1), ANN PENNY (3), BETTOR CALL LOU (7), BABY CHARLOTTE (4)

OUR ULTIMATE GRACY (1) will look for another all-the-way victory here after holding them off late following a fast burn early last start. She looks well placed with the dual claim to put another victory on the board. PHLOW JO (3) also uses a dual claim to get into this race and has been putting together some consistent performances of late. FAMILY REASONS (2) should get a nice sit with cover and looks the main danger, with plenty of ability on his day. LETSGOBRO (5) is going better than his form suggests and looks the only other likely winning chance if they are able to find a five-point claiming driver. Selections:OUR ULTIMATE GRACY (1), FAMILY REASONS (2), PHLOW JO (3), LETSGOBRO (5)

OUR SWEET TRIXIE (2) will be looking to use her good gate speed to be first to the pegs and attempt an all-the-way victory. She has been racing consistently of late and normally grows a leg in front, although she is better suited over the mile distance. Her chances could be reliant on whether she receives any pressure throughout, which is most likely to come from BUSLOAD OF FAITH (8), the lone back-row runner. MY BAD (3) produced an improved effort when second last start and should find a nice spot on speed with cover to be in the finish. OUR DANCE MONKEY (6) also ran well last start, only getting rolled in the final 50 metres after copping pressure throughout in handy time. If she settles better in the running, she could take some holding out late. SOLO SAFARI (7) is going better than his form suggests and will be reliant on a genuine tempo to be running home strongly, while DAISYPEA (5) only needs to bring some of her good two-year-old form to be a big danger, but may need to improve on her recent trial performances in what is a very even field. Selections:OUR SWEET TRIXIE (2), MY BAD (3), OUR DANCE MONKEY (6), DAISYPEA (5)

A strong field of mares comes together for the feature race, drawn on lifetime earnings, where the progressive CRAYONS TO PERFUME (1) will be looking to take advantage of the pole draw once again. There looks to be some good gate speed drawn to her outside, so the pressure could be on early. ULTIMACTION (6) returns from a good break after being in outstanding form last preparation, putting a string of victories together. She has trialled nicely for her return and expect her to be driven confidently from the wide gate. OUR NAKED ART (3) arrives in the state bringing some strong metropolitan form and, if able to find a spot on speed with cover, could take some holding out late. OUR WILLOW (4) has been consistent of late and is another who will be looking to slot in early to give herself her best chance. CARMEN EMJAY (9) returns after a strong second in the $100,000 Beautide and should be able to find a midfield position following out a handy beginner. SWIATEK LEIS (10) and STEPPING STONES (11) are the best performed mares of the field, hence drawing the worst, and will be relying on some genuine tempo up front to allow them to run home strongly late. Selections:ULTIMACTION (6),OUR NAKED ART (3), CARMEN EMJAY (9), CRAYONS TO PERFUME (1)

The Danbury Park Cup feature brings together a full field from the stand start over the long distance, where HORATIUS SPECULO (11) will be looking to add another victory to his name. He meets a stronger field today than he has at his past two starts, but you can't discount his class and he will be looking to use his speed late to be running home strongly. MAEBEE (10), GO THE RED (12) and BETTABLACK TIGER (13) are the other 20-metre runners and have all been racing consistently, so expect them to be running home strongly. THE SHALLOWS (9) is first up from a break but gets a 10-metre advantage and looks quite well handicapped at his best. ROCKANDAHARDPLACE (7) will look to ping to the front and run them along at his even tempo, where he does his best racing. I suspect the rest of the front-running horses will be battling it out for the placings at best, as they lack the class of some of the runners coming off the handicaps. Selections:HORATIUS SPECULO (11), THE SHALLOWS (9), GO THE RED (12), BETTABLACK TIGER (13)

WEE GEORGIE WOOD (1) again draws the pole, being a low lifetime-win horse, and should be best suited dropping back to the mile distance, where he does his best racing and has run some slick times recently. LAID BACK (2) gets the draw to find a nice spot on speed and will no doubt loom as a winning chance late. HAY MIKI (3) also draws the best he has in a while and will be looking to take up a forward position and find some cover, most likely off MY WAY (4), who you would expect to push forward again from the middle of the front row. MOVESLIKEALADY (11) draws her usual ODM position and will again be relying on some strong tempo throughout and a clever drive to get her home, but she can never be left out in these sorts of races. Selections:WEE GEORGIE WOOD (1), LAID BACK (2), HAY MIKI (3), MOVESLIKEALADY (11)

FARROH JOE (1) is a two-year-old taking on the older horses but looks extremely hard to beat over the short distance. He was good when sitting outside them and doing the work last week in the Dandy Patch heats and should be winning his tasbred bonus in the process here. SUMTHIN ELSE (2) has been okay in both starts this preparation and looks like getting another nice run on speed with cover, giving her every chance to run into the placings. KYRGIOS (3) and FEELINKINDALUCKY (4) may push forward from their middle front-row draws and hope to gain some cover from PUNTARNO STRIDE (7), who you would expect to be driven aggressively from the wide front-row draw, as he has been at previous starts. DEBT TILL WE PART (8) follows the expected favourite through from the back row and should get his chance to be in the finish if the gaps appear late. OVERVIEW:SECRET SERVICE AGENT (4) will appreciate a drop back in class for this assignment and will take beating. He had little luck from a wide draw when unplaced in the Super Series Final then raced on the outside of the leader throughout over the testing distance of 2760m in a heat of the Victoria Derby last outing. POPCORNFRIDAY (1) was held up for a run at a vital stage, angled wide at the 150m and finished strongly for seventh (2.5m) at Melton last outing. He is a short course specialist and should be reaching his peak after having two starts back from a break so he rates as a value hope. BRINGSUSJOY (3) was held up behind the tiring leader and didn’t have the best of luck when seventh at Metropolitan level last outing. She finished fast to win over Just As Well prior so she warrants respect. DONMARO (10) hasn’t produced his best form since coming from New Zealand but he should be fitter after his first up run and his form across the Tasman was good enough to be competitive here. BACK: SECRET SERVICE AGENT (4) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: SECRET SERVICE AGENT (4), POPCORNFRIDAY (1), BRINGSUSJOY (3), DONMARO (10)

OVERVIEW:TED BEAR (10) finished off strongly from the second half of the field when second behind Our Pinup Girl at Ballarat and followed with a seventh from a similar bad draw at Maryborough. He is likely to settle a long way back again from his similar draw here but he does strike a suitable line up. SPUN SILVER (6) continues to race in good form and should give a forward showing. She led throughout at a Kilmore victory three starts ago and attempted to lead throughout when third in a handy mile of 1.55.0 at Geelong. FLIGHT LOUTENANT (9) struck trouble at his debut for trainer Jess Tubbs after a third at Wagga. He has the perfect trailing draw and is worth another chance. HURRICANE HOOLY (3) is racing consistently and is perfectly drawn to suit her racing pattern. She was forced out very wide from the 400m and had excuses at her latest fourth. SELECTIONS: TED BEAR (10), SPUN SILVER (6), FLIGHT LOUTENANT (9), HURRICANE HOOLY (3)

OVERVIEW: BANIA (11) was heavily supported on debut but lost his chance after breaking stride at the start. He made up many lengths and did a good job to finish as close as he did so he is worth another chance. BAD GRANDMA (8) is awkwardly drawn but was impressive at a recent Melton trial victory in a mile rate of 1.58.0 so she must be respected. THE PRIVATE DEAL (5) is a former New South Wales pacer, which joins trainer Julie Douglas. She finished off quickly to win a Shepparton trial last week and she can improve on her numerical form. MILEY KAY (2) attempted to lead throughout and was run down on the line when a close second behind Cazadero at Swan Hill. This race is no harder and she is worth thought again. SEW HOPEFULL (3) led out then took cover and battled on fairly well for second behind Keayang Maricruz at Kilmore last outing. She is a maiden from 20 starts but she is a definite place chance again. SELECTIONS: BANIA (11), BAD GRANDMA (8), THE PRIVATE DEAL (5), MILEY KAY (2)

OVERVIEW: KOSIMO (8) appears to be very well placed against this line up with his claiming price of $8,000. He possesses a powerful finishing burst and his recent efforts have been in races boasting National Ratings of over 20 points higher than this event. MISTER AMERICANO (5) was resuming from a spell when fifth at Cranbourne, where he was held up for a run at a vital stage and finished off fairly well. He performed nicely at the trials prior and should go well against this opposition. LE GASTON (4) led throughout and scored over Storm Vendetta (won since) at Cranbourne on September 13. He has drawn poorly in two starts since and is capable of returning to winning form here. LENARD ESS (6) was suited by a genuine tempo in the early stages and ran over the top of his rivals to win in a mile of 1.55.5 at Geelong last outing. He has won three of his past five starts and should be finishing off nicely again. BACK: KOSIMO (8) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: KOSIMO (8), MISTER AMERICANO (5), LE GASTON (4), LENARD ESS (6)

OVERVIEW:TWIGSTAR (4) is a very promising filly that remains undefeated in two attempts and is the horse to beat again. She worked forward to find the lead and completely dominated her rivals at her latest Cranbourne success in a mile rate of 1.57.0. ARZALI ROCKSTAR (3) produced a big performance to score after racing on the outside of the leader throughout at Geelong last week. She is likely to be driven in a forward manner again and must be considered as one of the leading chances. BRAVE ART (2) copped plenty of pressure in the leading role and did a good job to hold down second in the race won by Lenard Ess last outing. She should give another bold showing from her good draw. OZZIE DIAMOND (1) failed to run on as expected last outing but she won at her two attempts prior and is worth another chance from the pole position. SANDELTON (7) remains undefeated in two starts but a negative swing in the barrier draw will make it a tougher task this evening. She did defeat ARZALI ROCKSTAR (3) at her latest success so she is not to be underestimated. BACK: TWIGSTAR (4) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: TWIGSTAR (4), ARZALI ROCKSTAR (3), BRAVE ART (2), OZZIE DIAMOND (1)

OVERVIEW:TASTE IT (3) led throughout at a Shepparton victory on September 01 and finished second from behind the leader at Shepparton last week. She is drawn to obtain a prominent position again and should go well. ALPHA CRUCIS (7) is poorly drawn but will appreciate a drop back in class for this assignment. He was held up for a run at a vital stage and used the sprint lane when an unlucky fifth (2m) at Melton two starts ago. LOAN SAILOR (8) was resuming since a win at Stawell when she galloped away and lost her chance at Geelong. She is not without a chance if she delivers a fool proof display. CHALKNCHEDDAR (4) ran a reasonable race from three back on the markers at Swan Hill last week and is worth a ticket each way in an open race. SELECTIONS: TASTE IT (3), ALPHA CRUCIS (7), LOAN SAILOR (8), CHALKNCHEDDAR (4)

OVERVIEW: MY ULTIMATE BARNEY (6) appears to be extremely well graded in this event and is clearly the horse to beat. He followed an eighth behind Bulletproof Boy in the Smoken Up Sprint with a strong effort in a heat of the South Australian Cup on Saturday night. JUSTALITTLESIP (5) was making ground out wide on the track but was severely checked with 150m remaining and lost his chance at Swan Hill last outing. He is also well placed in this event and should improve on his numerical form. IMA TERMINATOR (2) is a versatile pacer, which has the ability to show up under these conditions. He ran a reasonable race when fifth behind Ultimate Vinnie (won again since) in fast time at Ballarat last outing. PAS GUARANTEE (4) was held up for a run at a vital stage and finished off well for fourth when resuming. He should be fitter from that run and is capable of filling a place. BACK: MY ULTIMATE BARNEY (6) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: MY ULTIMATE BARNEY (6), JUSTALITTLESIP (5), IMA TERMINATOR (2), PAS GUARANTEE (4)

OVERVIEW: BEAUTIFUL SUNRISE (5) was resuming since March when she took advantage of a soft trip and finished off best to win at Geelong. She was in good form at the end of her last campaign and commenced her current preparation nicely so she should prove hard to beat again. CHINSKI (1) was attempting to hold the inside advantage but was checked and galloped on the first turn when an unlucky fifth at Geelong. He races best when he is able to lead so he has the conditions to suit him here. MASSIF CENTRAL (2) is also a fast beginner, which should be prominent throughout. He won from behind the leader at Kilmore three starts ago. GATESYS MATE (7) performed below expectations when he was resuming from a spell but this is a drop back in class and his form last preparation was good enough to be competitive under these conditions. SELECTIONS: BEAUTIFUL SUNRISE (5), CHINSKI (1), MASSIF CENTRAL (2), GATESYS MATE (7)

OVERVIEW:KEAYANG VIPER (9) has progressed to this level quickly as a lightly raced 4yo and has looked stylish in her eight career starts, which have yielded six wins, including a good-quality victory at Menangle in NSW last week. This stable has a very good strike rate with these progressive types, particularly those they've been patient with. While most of her wins have come from racing at the top end of the map, she has the speed and ability to overcome a less favourable position. GUNFORHIRE (7) is such a consistent type who, to be fair, hasn't had much luck with barrier draws, which has often hurt his winning strike rate. He will need luck again, but you know he'll be giving his all. SAVON DE ROCHE (8) has form around the top pick and has been terrific in those races, while also franked by her form either side of them. She's a little awkwardly drawn, but she's going too well not to consider. SPOOK CROCKER (4) is an interesting runner, with good Mount Gambier form, which rarely stacks up at this level, but he's worth keeping safe. PISTOL PEARCE (3) has the speed to lead and may find this a little more suitable, while PLATINUM JIVE (5) has her fair share of talent and has claims if she gets the luck she needs. BACK: KEAYANG VIPER (9) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:KEAYANG VIPER (9), GUNFORHIRE (7), SAVON DE ROCHE (8), PLATINUM JIVE (5)

OVERVIEW:JILLIBY SNIPER (4) looks a nice 3yo who, like his stablemate in Race 1, has reached this level very quickly, with five wins from nine starts. He had a crack at qualifying for the Derby, and even though he dropped back to a more suitable grade last time, the quality of the opposition was strong. He has the barrier draw advantage over his main rival, Thunderfire, which may be the decisive factor. THUNDERFIRE (10) has been terrific in his lightly raced career of only 11 starts, and you can mount a case that he's been most unlucky not to register more than four wins. He was terrific through the Vicbred Series and lost no admirers last week when sitting parked in good time and sticking on gamely. He's a versatile type who can work or come with one run, so has that in his favour to overcome the back-row draw. BANDIT EYES (7) failed last start at Wagga but was terrific in winning here the start prior when able to lead all the way in good time. If he recaptures that form, he's well in the mix to win again, while stablemate REFUSAL (8) also creates plenty of interest having her first start for the camp. While she needs to improve significantly, this stable has a good record with new acquisitions. While there's confidence around the top two picks, the minor end is wide open, with RONNIE THE HAMMER (6), TELEMACHUS (9) and KING SAINT (11) all in with a show. BACK: JILLIBY SNIPER (4) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:JILLIBY SNIPER (4), THUNDERFIRE (11), BANDIT EYES (7), TELEMACHUS (9)

OVERVIEW:QUIRKY CHARACTER (5) may fly under the radar here considering his numerical form, but he's been going okay from bad draws, running good times from unwinnable positions. He'll have a few in front of him again here, but there could be a bit of early speed to help him, and the smaller field to round them up is also in his favour. He should be a nice value play. KEAYANG LAVITA (4) has been mixing it between standing starts and mobile conditions and racing well. Her failures have often been the result of having to do too much work in quick time. She has speed, but so do a couple inside and outside her, so the map could be a little tricky. However, if she gets the right trip, she's hard to beat. KARBINE (3) has really delivered on his potential this preparation, winning six of 23 starts, with a couple of those victories coming in town at a good level. He can float into a nice enough position from the draw, and his tough run last start is worth forgiving as he looks to bounce back. IRON WOMEN (1) can be expected to utilise her speed from the pole draw, and over this trip that's a big advantage. She is up in grade, however, so she may feel the pressure late. The chances don't end there, with MAORIS MAC (6) possessing good ability, and even NAKEDTRUTH (2), EL RESAMO (7) and MEADOW VALLEY STAR (9) wouldn't shock the way they're going, as they can perform at this level with the right run. It's an open race. SELECTIONS:QUIRKY CHARACTER (5), KEAYANG LAVITA (4), KARBINE (3), IRON WOMEN (1)

OVERVIEW:TIMMY TURTLE (4) looks very well placed against this line-up, considering his form last season against some quality types. He now has the benefit of one run back from a long break, where he ran well without being knocked around. He goes to the front row now to utilise his gate speed over the short trip, and if he's come on from last start, he looks very hard to beat and one of the best of the night. KEAYANG GYPSY (7) is ever consistent and racing well this preparation. Despite the draw, connections may elect to roll forward under these favourable conditions to race close to the speed. She was racing smarter types last time, albeit in a small field. DELS DESTINY (5) is often dependent on tempo, as he's a sit-and-sprint type, but he's been in nice form of late, including a win here two starts back. Look for him late. KYVALLEY MICHAEL (8) was racing well, but he's been off his game in his past few runs. He's back in a suitable grade, so improvement wouldn't surprise. HAY JET (3) is a most interesting runner who hasn't been seen since 2024, when he notched three wins from three starts in easier grade. He's had one trial leading into this, where they didn't go overly quickly, but he did hit the line well, although he looked to be knocking up late. He will need the run but watch him with interest. BACK: TIMMY TURTLE (4) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS:TIMMY TURTLE (4), KEAYANG GYPSY (7), DELS DESTINY (5), KYVALLEY MICHAEL (8)

OVERVIEW:COLTRANE (6) made a nice return last start at Geelong, where he drifted back and copped a check from an unruly runner. He took a bit of time to get balanced thereafter, but when he did, he hit the line very well. There doesn't look to be much pressure in the race, which is a slight concern for a horse who likes to come with one run, but he looks to have more upside than most of the opposition here. AGAINST THE BRIDLE (7) is in a purple patch of form, and that's largely due to his manners and ability to put himself up on the pace and grind them down. That pattern may make him a sitting shot for the favourite, but he'll be in it for a long way. CALABASAS (3) is worth forgiving for her last run, where she started off the back row and was wiped out at the start. Prior to that, she was a winner at this track, albeit in an easier race, but deserves consideration. NIGHT FLIGHT (2) is a very quick beginner and looks a comfortable leader here. He's been consistent this season and is a threat over the short trip, but he's come up empty-handed in six starts at this track. BACK: COLTRANE (6) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:COLTRANE (6), AGAINST THE BRIDLE (7), CALABASAS (3), NIGHT FLIGHT (2)

OVERVIEW:ROCKY VALLEY (2) could be open to sharp improvement here, getting a good draw to show his versatility against opposition that seems more favourable than what he's been facing. He did lead and fade over the longer trip three back, but maybe he spent too many tickets early, whereas this draw seems a lot more favourable to have a look for the top or find good cover. He can give a sight at decent value. ALDEBARAN SUSANNE (6) returns to the front row and can show her good gate speed from the same draw she was able to find the pegs from three back, where she finished a good 2nd. This trip and class suit her, and she will be hard to beat. CARLA PIXIE (8) returns to mobile conditions, which is preferable after a few standing starts in SA. Prior to that, she ran some nice races at this track from the same draw with a low SP profile, so she's in the mix again despite needing some luck. ALDEBARAN SUE (7) hasn't been trotting well since her stint in Queensland, but it's hard to leave her out against this opposition considering her ability. If she can show any glimpse of what she's capable of, improvement wouldn't surprise. SELECTIONS:ROCKY VALLEY (2), ALDEBARAN SUSANNE (6), CARLA PIXIE (8), ALDEBARAN SUE (7)

OVERVIEW:KENNYS SON (5) is a quick beginner under mobile conditions and gets the opportunity to race forward here and be given every hope over the short trip. He was able to lead and win in good time at Shepparton two runs back with Herbertson aboard and has a decent record at this track to suggest that if he gets the right trip, he's the one to catch. LOCKSLEY CAVALIER (6) was well supported here when first up, but he ran well below par and was sent back to the trials. He stepped out well in that trial to suggest the performance may have been an anomaly. He has shown decent ability at a stronger level than he meets here, so expect him to bounce back quickly. DOSSIER (2) is starting to get back to some decent form with a couple of placings recently. She has won at this track in this type of grade, and the soft draw helps her chances of going close. MISS KOMMUNICATION (3), MAJESTIC MONARCH (4) and KYVALLEY JAGGER (8) would all surprise with victory but have claims at the minor end. BACK: KENNYS SON (5) – 1 unit (win) SELECTIONS:KENNYS SON (5), LOCKSLEY CAVALIER (6), DOSSIER (2), MAJESTIC MONARCH (4)

OVERVIEW:ISOLATION (7) drops back significantly in grade after a good 3rd here last week, where he didn't have the best luck in transit early and still found the line well. He's reunited with Herbertson here, who tends to get the best out of him, evidenced by driving four of his five wins this season. The extra distance helps him take up a forward position and control the tempo from the top end, making him hard to run down. SEATHESTARS (4) is a high-quality 4yo who comes here third up after two runs in the Vicbred Series, the first where he was very good when 3rd and able to map behind the leader, then was beaten a long way in the final without an obvious excuse. He's now had a month between runs, and if you purely assess him on the terrific runs he put in last season in the top 3yo races, he's clearly got the class, but it's hard to know where he's at. TOORAM MAGIC (6) resumed with a nice 2nd behind an in-form horse last time out and strung together some solid performances last campaign. The map might be a little tricky, but if he gets a good trail into it, he can finish off late. MY LITTLE BO (2) is a quick beginner and will look to map behind the leader or, most likely, three pegs. She's much better over the short trip, but her run here last week was solid enough to consider. SELECTIONS:ISOLATION (7), SEATHESTARS (4), TOORAM MAGIC (6), MY LITTLE BO (2)

OVERVIEW:RUBYS DREAM (5) is a very quick beginner, evidenced by her two recent wins here from gates five and seven, where she was able to lead over the short trip and run very good time for this grade. This race doesn't present as any harder than last time, so if she can cross and lead, a repeat of that performance can be enough to get the job done. IJUSTCALLEDTOSAY (6) is a high-quality opponent who's turned in some terrific runs this season, including three wins. He's most likely forced into a map-negative position here, which will make it hard to bridge the margin to the leaders, but he'll be giving his all. FREIGHT SHAKER (2) is another consistent type drawn favourably to get a nice map from the inside draw. He ran a PB time last time out, and if he can improve on that, he can go close. The rest all have claims at the minor end, with a slight leaning towards KEAYANG KURKI (7) as the best of those. SELECTIONS:RUBYS DREAM (5), IJUSTCALLEDTOSAY (6), FREIGHT SHAKER (2), KEAYANG KURKI (7)

TASK AT HAND (3) did things wrong on debut and was beaten a long way as a result. She took on a stronger race last time out and battled on well enough there for fifth. She should find this easier. HEIRTOTHECROWN (4) ran well on debut when running into second behind Jewel Reason. He looks to draw a touch awkwardly this time but comes into this race third up and is likely to have derived a lot of benefit from his first two outings at the races. AIMEES ALIAS (9) has been good in recent outings when getting back and running on late. She got back on the pegs last time out and ran on strongly there into a close up third. She should be running on again. FORGETTABLE (2) was given a touch trip when working around to the breeze and being beaten a long way last time out. He draws more favourably this time and may be able to lead before having options from there. SELECTIONS: TASK AT HAND (3), HEIRTOTHECROWN (4), AIMEES ALIAS (9), FORGETTABLE (2) SUGGESTED BET: TASK AT HAND (3) to win.

PICCOLO DIAVOLO (6) was able to sit without cover last time out and ran well finishing a close up second to Blackjack who has made a promising start to his QLD racing career. He draws poorly in this race but is versatile in this type of grade and should run well again. NUMBER ONE RANGER (5) draws a touch awkwardly in this race outside the front row and will need a few things to go his way in the run. He took on a strong race last time out which was taken out by Rock Nien and should find this a bit easier. SLAY QUEEN (3) starts in this race first up from a spell and draws reasonably. She did run good time as a 2YO in WA when getting back and running over the top over the 1730 at Gloucester Park. CALL KELLY (4) secured a good run last time out 1 out 1 back and just couldn’t quite finish it off there when running fourth. She has good ability and should run well if she can find some of her better form. SELECTIONS: PICCOLO DIAVOLO (6), NUMBER ONE RANGER (5), SLAY QUEEN (3), CALL KELLY (4) SUGGESTED BET: PICCOLO DIAVOLO (6) to win.

ROSIE POLLEN (10) has been racing well recently in what may have been slightly stronger company. She secured a good run two back and was good when running into fourth late behind Playing For Keeps. She should run well again. SAINT LOUIS BEAT (6) looks well placed in this race but does draw poorly outside the front and will need a few things to go his way in the run. Zipped across early two back before taking a sit on Playing For Keeps and was running on nicely into second. CAPTAIN OH CAPTAIN (9) sat without cover three starts ago and was able to battle on well for third there behind Illbewatching. He should get a good run off the speed in this race and can be running on late. HIGHVIEW SADLER (5) secured a good run on the pegs last time out and was running on reasonably well late. He is likely to get back again in this race and will just need the race run to suit. SELECTIONS: ROSIE POLLEN (10), SAINT LOUIS BEAT (6), CAPTAIN OH CAPTAIN (9), HIGHVIEW SADLER (5) SUGGESTED BET: ROSIE POLLEN (10) to win.

WICKED MACK (1) led last time out and battled on well enough for third behind dominant winner Britts Mate who has been racing in very good form. He should be able to lead again in this race and may appreciate the step back to the 1780. MAYWYNS ACE (8) doesn’t win often but does appear to find a very suitable race where he draws to do no work early. He secured a good run last time out over the 2040 and couldn’t quite finish that race off but may be better suited over the 1780 in this race. CHEEKY BABY (7) should get a good run through in this race behind the likely leader early in this race. She secured a similar run four starts ago and was able to sprint best there to score a nice win. MAJOR ARK (2) was able to win first up last time out when beating Jukebox Jet and is likely to have derived good benefit from the outing. He draws favourably in this race and should settle close enough in the run. SELECTIONS: WICKED MACK (1), MAYWYNS ACE (8), CHEEKY BABY (7), MAJOR ARK (2) SUGGESTED BET: WICKED MACK (1) to win.

BEACH MAGIC (1) has good gate speed and should be able to drive through and lead in this race. He put in a good run last time out when running on strongly into second last start behind Major Slip Up. SHEZ A WARRIOR (8) should get a good run off the speed in this race and appears to find a slightly easier race than his recent outings. She ran on well into third behind The Tiger Army last time out and should be running on again in this race. ONE CHAIN ROAD (3) has plenty of gate speed and should find a prominent position in this race. He led last time out and wasn’t quite at his absolute best there when well beaten by Milliewood at Albion Park. LAST CALL (9) secured a good run two starts ago and was running on strongly into second behind The Tiger Army. She should get a good run off the speed in this race and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: BEACH MAGIC (1), SHEZ A WARRIOR (8), ONE CHAIN ROAD (3), LAST CALL (9) SUGGESTED BET: BEACH MAGIC (1) to win.

MIRACLE MOOSE (10) has been taking on much stronger fields in recent outings including last time out when not beaten far by Fate Awaits at Albion Park. He draws outside the back row but finds a race which could generate a strong early tempo which brings him right into it. CALLING BUDDY (6) looked to be a tragedy beaten last time out when badly inconvenienced at a crucial stage of the race before finishing it off strongly late making up plenty of ground. He may get back in this race and can be running on strongly late. TILLY JAYNE (5) sat outside the leader last time out and battled on nicely there for second behind King Bobbie who rated good enough time for the grade. She may be forced to work again but is racing well. COMMODORE JUJON (7) should get a good run through in this race behind a horse with good gate speed. He has always liked racing at this track and trip and should be hard to beat with luck at the right time. SELECTIONS: MIRACLE MOOSE (10), CALLING BUDDY (6), TILLY JAYNE (5), COMMODORE JUJON (7) SUGGESTED BET: MIRACLE MOOSE (10) to win.

THE TIGER ARMY (6) was able to score a good win last time out when edging to the lead late in the race having sat without cover and looked beaten at a number of stages. He draws widest and will need a few things to go his way. WEHAVTIME (2) has good gate speed and may look to press to the lead early in this race from a good draw. He really caught the eye three starts ago when flashing into second late behind Longshot at Albion Park. BRITTS MATE (8) got back in the run last time out and ran over the top to score a dominant win in an easier race. She steps up in grade but stays at the same trip she has had good success at and should be hard to beat again. KEAYANG MOSCATO (5) sat without cover last time out and was beaten a long way there after over racing. She draws poorly this time and will need a few things to go her way but is capable at her best. SELECTIONS: THE TIGER ARMY (6), WEHAVTIME (2), BRITTS MATE (8), KEAYANG MOSCATO (5) SUGGESTED BET: BRITTS MATE (8) to win.

MISTER FREEMAN (1) doesn’t have brilliant gate speed and will be doing his best to drive through and lead in this race from the ideal draw. He was able to secure a good run behind Rock Nien last time out and battled on well there for third at this track. SAME OLD DEVIL (4) ran a very good race last time out when racing off the pegs and still running on nicely late into second. He should get a similar run in this race and should be right in the finish if he can repeat his latest effort. IM BUSTED (3) led three starts ago and was able to take them all the way scoring a nice win over Toro Loco. He returns after a month off in this race and with the right run should be thereabouts late. SATURDAY DANCE (7) should get a good run through behind a horse which will be keen to hold a forward position in this race. She seems to love racing on the pegs behind the speed and was able to secure a good run four starts ago at Marburg when rating good time beating Pumpkin Pat. SELECTIONS: MISTER FREEMAN (1), SAME OLD DEVIL (4), IM BUSTED (3), SATURDAY DANCE (7) SUGGESTED BET: MISTER FREEMAN (1) to win.

JIVE MASTER (7) should get a good run through behind the likely leader in the race. He got back in the run three starts ago and was able to run over the top to score a nice win at this track over the 2040. MULLUM DOC (1) has plenty of gate speed and may be able to drive through and lead early in this race from the ideal draw. He got dragged out of the race at a crucial stage last time out and finished it off quite well once clear. LETHAL LOUIE (6) draws poorly in this race outside the front row and will need the race run to suit to get into the finish. He got back last time out and couldn’t get into the race there which was taken out by Glenledi Boy who had the perfect leaders back trail. B MAC C (8) sat close to the speed last time out and was well beaten in a race taken out by Glenledi Boy. He should secure a good run behind the speed and could be suited by the step back in distance. SELECTIONS: JIVE MASTER (7), MULLUM DOC (1), LETHAL LOUIE (6), B MAC C (8) SUGGESTED BET: JIVE MASTER (7) to win.
